name: Valdelaguna (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdelaguna (chequy of yellow and black, an aqueduct on red and mountains above waves).
history: In 1987 Investigaciones Heráldicas Agar, commissioned by the municipal corporation, concluded that Valdelaguna had never had its own arms and flag, and designed the blazon and the flag, which were approved on 8 June 1989 after publication in the BOCM; the yellow flag with the arms at the centre takes the predominant colour of the arms, in which the Roman aqueduct of Segovia recalls the community and land to which the village belonged.
